what: Avantor supplies laboratories: chemicals, reagents, lab equipment, single-use bioprocessing components and the services that keep a lab stocked and running.
customers: Pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturers, universities, hospitals and industrial laboratories.
money: chemicals, consumables and lab services distribution
single-use components and materials for drug manufacturing
moat: Materials written into customers' approved manufacturing processes and a distribution footprint inside their buildings, where changing supplier means revalidating a process.
risks: Revenue has fallen for four years running, from $7.5B to $6.6B
$4.1B of debt against $365M of cash, from the leveraged buyout history
A reported loss on an operating basis after goodwill write-downs
opportunities: $439M of free cash flow is going to debt reduction
Analysts see about 15% upside, with 13 covering the stock
The bioprocessing half serves drug manufacturing, which grows with new biologic approvals
watch: Organic revenue growth, which has to stop falling, and the debt level.
